# LitZentrum

Canonical repository: https://github.com/doc-bricks/LitZentrum

LitZentrum is a local-first PySide6 desktop application for academic literature management. It stores projects as UTF-8 JSON files in user-owned folders and supports source metadata, notes, quotes, tasks, summaries, PDF workflows, BibTeX export and optional local Ollama-assisted features.

Important files:
- `README.md`: English project overview.
- `README_de.md`: German project overview.
- `EXPORTFORMAT.md`: Human-readable description of `litzentrum-library-v1.json`.
- `schemas/litzentrum-library-v1.schema.json`: JSON schema for the read-only companion export.
- `src/core/library_export.py`: Export implementation.
- `tests/test_library_export.py`: Regression tests for UTF-8, relative paths, missing PDFs and empty projects.

Privacy and scope:
- The default companion export does not embed PDF files.
- The default companion export does not include absolute local paths.
- The app is designed for local use and user-controlled exports, not server-side library hosting.
